headline: TSLA closes at $420.01 on May 11 (+3.89%) despite premarket pressure — stock slipped 1% at open on Cybertruck RWD recall + China retail sales data, then reversed to close +3.89% as robotaxi momentum narrative dominated; +33% off the post-earnings $373 low set Apr 23; stock approaching $425 resistance; +12.6% YTD; bull case: EV/energy at $400, Optimus/AI/robotaxi unpriced upside above that level (basenor.com / Yahoo Finance)

Piper Sandler reiterates Tesla Overweight / $500 PT — says at current ~$400/share, Tesla's EV and energy businesses alone justify the full price, meaning Optimus, robotaxi network, and AI inference are effectively 'free' for investors; analyst Alex Potter argues conventional DCF gives you the steel/battery business at fair value and the AI upside is unpriced option value; $100 of upside = pure robotics + autonomy premium (Seeking Alpha / Investing.com / Yahoo Finance)

Tesla China retail sales fell 10% YoY in April to 25,956 units — domestic sales fell 15% YoY; the widely reported '+36% April surge' was wholesale/export output from Giga Shanghai including European and APAC exports, NOT Chinese consumer purchases; Q1 2026 China retail crashed 16% YoY with January alone down 45%; Tesla now risks falling behind Xiaomi in China market share by end of 2026 as domestic BEV market grew +2.4% YoY in April; bear signal for the China delivery recovery thesis (Electrek / CnEVPost / basenor.com)

Tesla recalls all 173 Cybertruck RWD units ever sold — faulty brake rotor stud holes crack under load, wheel studs can shear, wheels can fall off at speed; only base-18-inch RWD units affected; embarrassingly low total volume (173 total) confirms the ~$70K entry Cybertruck failed to find market traction; 3 warranty claims identified, no injuries; adds to pattern of Cybertruck production quality concerns and SpaceX-inflated sales data; stock slipped 1% premarket on the news (NHTSA / KBB / Carscoops)

Austin robotaxi fleet: 50 active rider vehicles + 38 Cybercabs in test fleet; unsupervised ride rate hits 66.7% — 28 of 42 rides in last 7 days with no safety driver; up from 59.0% on May 8 and 27.8% on May 6; fleet now operating unsupervised during evening hours for first time as of May 4; pace of autonomous operational maturity accelerating sharply across both daytime and night sessions (robotaxitracker.com / Teslarati)

Tesla builds last-ever Model S and Model X at Fremont — factory line now converting to Optimus production; Fremont line targeting 1M robots/year at full capacity; Signature Edition final delivery event for existing reservation holders originally set May 12 but has since been postponed; end of Tesla's flagship luxury EV era marks the beginning of its robotics-first manufacturing era (evxl.co / notateslaapp / Electrek / TeslaNorth)

SpaceX formally files plan revealing Terafab chip factory costs $55B–$119B — joint Tesla/SpaceX semiconductor facility in Texas enters formal planning phase; research fab at Giga Texas (~$3B) will produce AI5-class chips in small batches; full Terafab scope $55B minimum with total exceeding $119B; Intel 14A process confirmed; SpaceX filing notes 'no assurance' on timeline execution; one of the largest private infrastructure investments in history if fully built (CNBC / Bloomberg / Reuters)

WattEV orders 370 Tesla Semi trucks in a landmark $100M deal — California's largest-ever single electric truck order; 50 trucks deliver in 2026 with full fleet by end 2027; 300+ units to support Port of Oakland freight electrification; WattEV CEO cited Tesla Semi's 'cost, performance, and availability' as decisive factors vs. competitors; signals major fleet-scale enterprise adoption accelerating alongside Gigafactory Nevada volume ramp (Teslarati / ACT Expo)
